meta.title: Bagno Marè | Beach club and seafood kitchen in Cesenatico
meta.description: Bagno Marè, Molo di Levante 74, Cesenatico. Beach, breakfast from our own bakery, seafood lunch and dinner. Book your table online.
meta.og_description: The Levante beach, a seafood kitchen, evenings on the pier.

hero.lead: Kitchen, café, beach and shop on the Molo di Levante. Arrive in your swimsuit, stay for dinner.
hero.img_main: The boardwalk between white parasols leading to the sea
hero.img_aside: Beach cabins number 20 and 21, wooden with pale blue stripes

place.statement: A row of white parasols, the pale wood of the beach cabins, a kitchen that cooks fish from the Adriatic. The rest is up to the day.
place.text: We are on the Levante beach, right by the pier. People come for the sea and stay for the table: breakfast from our bakery, lunch in the shade, an aperitivo as the light fades, dinner by candlelight.

day.title: From eight in the morning until after dinner.
day.s1_text: Well spaced parasols, hot showers and a first swim in a calm sea.
day.s2_text: Pastries from our bakery, organic yogurt and toast until noon.
day.s3_text: Seafood cooking, a few steps from your parasol.
day.s4_text: Romagna flatbread, pan pizza and raw seafood platters to share.
day.s5_text: Low lights, white tablecloths and the pier in front of you.

beach.img: Two paddle boards leaning against a striped cabin, next to an olive tree in a pot
beach.caption: Paddle boards for hire, on the boardwalk.
beach.title: The Levante beach.
beach.text: Rows parallel to the sea and more than four and a half metres between parasols. There is room to breathe even in August, from morning to sunset.
beach.fig1: between one parasol and the next
beach.fig3: beach volleyball and beach soccer courts
beach.g3_2: Paddle boards, canoes and pedal boats for hire
beach.note: For parasols, sunbeds and tents please ask at the beach directly. Services and prices may change during the season.

kitchen.title: Seafood cooking.
kitchen.text: Filled, fresh or extruded pasta, always made in house. Fish from the small boats of the Cesenatico fleet, raw, baked or in a brodetto stew. The menu follows the market.
kitchen.img_a: Pasta with beans and green sauce served on a white plate from a copper pan
kitchen.img_b: Nests of freshly rolled pasta on a tray
kitchen.dishes_note: A selection. The full menu changes with the season.
kitchen.d1_desc: Viennoiserie, craquelin choux and puff pastries, every morning while they last.
kitchen.d2_desc: Passatelli, seafood, shellfish and cuttlefish lard.
kitchen.d3_desc: Salt cod with rosemary, water onion and truffle.
kitchen.d4_desc: With vinegar, shellfish and bread to mop it up. Also gluten free.
kitchen.d5_desc: Cocktails, filled flatbread and pan pizza to share.
kitchen.d6_desc: Sparkling wines, local whites and labels from around the world.
kitchen.files_note: The PDF menus are in Italian. Our staff will gladly help you choose.

evening.img_main: A table set with candles on the terrace, the harbour and the sea at sunset
evening.title: Evenings on the pier.
evening.text: When the beach empties, the dining room lights up: lanterns, birdcages hanging from the ceiling, white tablecloths and the harbour a few steps away.
evening.img_wide: The dining room at night with the striped cabins lit in the background
evening.img_tall: A long table with candles and flowers, in the evening
evening.events_text: Birthdays, company dinners and weddings on the sand. Write to us and we will plan the evening together.
evening.img_small: White birdcages hanging from the ceiling beams

cta.title: A table with a sea view.
cta.text: Choose lunch or dinner, the day and the time. We only ask how many you are, a name and a way to reach you.
cta.alt: Would you rather talk to us?

faq.title: Before you come.
faq.a1: Choose lunch or dinner, the day, the number of guests and one of the available times. Leave your name, phone number and, if you like, an email and a note. When our staff confirm the request, or if they cannot accept it, we write to you by email or text message.
faq.q2: I can’t see any available times. Why?
faq.a2: We are closed that day, or that time is already fully booked. Try another time, another day, or call us: sometimes a table frees up.
faq.a3: Season dates, opening hours for each service and planned closures are in the Contact section and are updated whenever they change. Closed days cannot be selected in the booking calendar.
faq.a4: Online bookings are for tables of up to 12 people. For larger groups, company dinners or private parties write to info@mareconlaccento.it.
faq.q5: Can I book a parasol here?
faq.a5: No, the online form is for the restaurant only. For parasols, sunbeds and tents please ask at the beach directly.
faq.q6: I have an allergy or intolerance.
faq.a6: Mention it in the booking notes and remind our staff before ordering. Many dishes are available gluten free and the allergen sheet can be downloaded from the kitchen section.
faq.q7: Are you coming with small children?
faq.a7: Let us know in the notes and we will have a high chair ready. There is a playground for little ones on the beach.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How Bagno Marè handles the data of online bookings.
privacy.draft: Draft to be completed with the controller’s details and reviewed before publication.
privacy.lead: This notice explains which data we collect when you book a table online, why we use it and how long we keep it.
privacy.owner: [Company name], Molo di Levante 74, 47042 Cesenatico (FC), Italy, VAT number [to be completed]. Contact: info@mareconlaccento.it.
privacy.data: Name, phone number, email if you give it, day, service, time, number of guests, optional notes, page language and any campaign parameters you arrive with (UTM). To limit repeated submissions the server keeps the sender’s IP address in memory for one hour.
privacy.purpose_booking: Handling your booking request and your table: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR).
privacy.purpose_messages: Sending you the confirmation, refusal or cancellation of your booking by email or text message: only with your consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
privacy.purpose_security: Protecting the form from abuse and automated submissions: legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f GDPR).
privacy.providers: Data is stored on the server hosting the site ([hosting provider]). Emails are sent through [email provider] and text messages through [SMS provider], appointed as data processors. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives the browser’s IP address.
privacy.retention: Bookings are kept for [12] months after the date of the service, then deleted or anonymised.
privacy.rights: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of your data, object to processing and withdraw consent by writing to info@mareconlaccento.it. You may also lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).
